description: Drafts a complete request for quotation in German or English following the Execution Toolkit template T10 (RFQ): title, RFQ number, issue and due date, buyer and contact, 1 scope and requirements, 2 commercial response table with the user's lines (description, specification, quantity, unit, delivery), 3 submission checklist and timeline with a question deadline, 4 weighted evaluation criteria (the user's own or a suggestion: price and total cost 40, quality 25, delivery 15, service 10, terms and risk 10), 5 clarifications in writing, 6 compliance and terms with payment terms, offer validity and governing law. Missing details are left as clearly marked placeholders in square brackets, never invented. Returns the full text ready to paste into an email or document, plus the link to the Excel template T10 that fill_template can fill. Working template, not legal advice. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

criteria.description: Evaluation criteria with weights (any scale, normalised to 100).

weight.description: Weight of the criterion; any scale, normalised to 100.

due_date.description: Submission deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Default issue date plus 14 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

lines.description: Lines: description, specs, qty, unit, delivery.

scope.description: Goods or services, objective and expected outcome.

validity.description: How long offers must stay valid, e.g. 90 days.

due_time.description: Time of day of the deadline, e.g. 12:00.

title.description: What the request is about, e.g. 'Cleaning of the office building from 2027'.

name: create_rfq
title: Draft a request for quotation (RFQ) from the KULIC Advisory RFQ template: scope, requirements, response table, checklist, timeline, criteria, terms
